verdict.rationale: Asking whether user data can be excluded from AI training is a fair privacy question for any online service that handles filings and personal data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions AI or model training. The only nearby feature is confidentiality and anonymization of filed acts and personal data (docs-16), which is a different control and earns no credit for an AI-training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
